_comment: Model prices for utils/extract_run_log.py --rates, in USD per million tokens.
These rates are used ONLY to ESTIMATE the spend of sessions whose transcript is gone
(cron transcripts are deleted when the job next runs; only the trajectory's run-level
token counts survive). Recorded cost always comes from usage.cost.total on the
assistant records in the session store, deduplicated by responseId, and is never
Precedence: a model that has priced records in the store is calibrated from those
records (OpenClaw's own pricing table, as charged); this file only fills in models
with no priced records. A model in neither place is reported under
cost.unpricedModels and its trajectory-only runs contribute no estimate.
cacheWrite is the 5-minute-TTL rate (1.25x input); with cacheRetention=long the
provider bills 2x input — run_summary.json reports both bases.
Copy to rates.json, edit for the models the run actually used.
